fix(sim): give block ids 64 and above real properties instead of the air fallback
test(gameplay,sim): guard v2 registry coverage, recipe count and the sim v2 band

notes: B-01 root cause: the default registries stopped at the v1 tables, so all 18 BLOCK_V2 ids (64-81) and all 18 ITEM_V2 ids (305-322) returned undefined from BLOCKS.tryById and ITEMS.tryById, RECIPES shipped 53 of the 58 recipes in createV2RecipeRegistry, and packages/sim had no entries above id 63.

packages/gameplay/src/v2blocks/blockDefsV2.ts is the new v2 block definition table: hardness, tool class and tier, drops, opacity, skyPassThrough, simSolid, simReplaceable and render layer for every BLOCK_V2 id. blockItemsV2.ts adds the matching block items so every v2 block can be placed from the inventory.

BLOCKS, ITEMS and RECIPES are now built from ALL_BLOCK_DEFS, ALL_ITEM_DEFS and ALL_RECIPE_DEFS (v1 plus v2). RECIPES.count() equals createV2RecipeRegistry().count() (58) and every RECIPE_V2_ID resolves, so the five v2 recipes including BreadFromWheat ship by default.

createV2ItemRegistry moved from v2items/itemDefsV2.ts to the new v2items/registryV2.ts so that items/registry.ts can import the v2 item defs without an import cycle. It is still exported from the package barrel, so no caller changes.

packages/sim/src/shared/blockProps.ts now covers ids 64 and above: the 11 full cube v2 blocks are opaque (opacity MAX_LIGHT), solid and sky blocking; cobblestone wall, fence and fence gate collide without blocking light; the three crops and the Nether portal plane stay passable and replaceable; magma blocks emit 3 and the portal emits PORTAL.lightLevel.

Lighting, fluids and collision now agree with the block definitions: packages/gameplay/src/v2blocks/v2blocks.test.ts compares the gameplay definition and the sim table field by field for every v2 id and asserts no solid v2 block measures like AIR.

That gameplay-versus-sim comparison is intentionally limited to v2 ids. A v1 id already disagrees at HEAD (BLOCK.GLASS is fullCube true in gameplay and false in sim); that is pre-existing and was left untouched.

World generation coverage: the regression generates the 5x5 chunk region around the seed 1337 village (block x 72, z 632), decorates it, and also generates a 3x3 Nether region, then asserts every emitted block id resolves in BLOCKS. The 126 village voxels that used to be undefined are now all registry-defined, breakable and placeable.

packages/gameplay/src/__tests__/v2Systems.integration.test.ts drives XP, enchanting, farming and breeding end to end through the package public API only: till and hydrate farmland, plant, random tick to maturity, harvest, craft bread from the shipped RECIPES; count bookshelves at a real enchanting table, roll offers, earn levels from quartz ore breaks and pay for an offer; feed a cow pair wheat, breed it for BREEDING.xpOnBreed and grow the baby with tickHerd. Nothing was wired into apps/game or packages/client, which other sessions own.
packages/sim/src/shared/blockPropsV2.test.ts guards the v2 band inside the package that owns the table, so the sim suite fails on its own if an id of 64 or more falls back to the air entry again.
No dependency or contract changes: packages/core-types was not touched, packages/gameplay already depended on @voxelcraft/world and @voxelcraft/sim, and no npm dependency was added.

packages/gameplay/src/blocks/registry.ts, items/registry.ts and crafting/crafting.test.ts were already prettier-dirty at 687ff6b, so they were left unformatted rather than reformatted in this branch. eslint passes on every package.
This report is committed on top of head_sha as a separate docs commit, so the pushed branch tip is that report commit.
